originalTitle: '101-year-old great-grandmother' arrested for selling cannabis in Nigeria
title: A Very Old Mama and the Special Plant!
content:
Hello, Friends from Africa!

Hello, amazing friends from all over Africa! It's your kid-friendly reporter here, ready to share a story from our big continent. Today, we're going on a little trip to a country called Nigeria. Nigeria is a really big and sunny place in West Africa, full of wonderful people and delicious food. We're going to talk about a very special, very old mama, and a little bit about why it's super important to follow rules. Come along, let's learn together!

Meet Mama Esther: A Very Old Mama!

In Nigeria, there lives a mama named Esther Ogunmabo. But she's not just any mama. She is a *very* old mama! Can you guess how old she is? She is 101 years old! Wow! That's older than your granny, and even older than your granny's granny! That means she has seen so many years, so many sunrises, and so many exciting things happen in the world. Mama Esther is what we call a 'great-grandmother'. Do you know what that means? It means she has children, and those children have children, and *those* children have children too! So, she has lots and lots of family who love her. Imagine all those birthdays she has celebrated! It's very special to be 101 years old. Did you know? Being 101 years old makes Mama Esther one of the oldest people you might ever hear about in the news! Most people don't live that long. She has seen a whole century go by!

What is the "Special Plant"?

Now, here's where the story gets a little bit tricky, but don't worry, we'll make it simple. There are many kinds of plants in the world, right? Some plants give us yummy food like mangoes and maize. Some plants give us beautiful flowers like hibiscus and roses. And some plants give us medicine to help us feel better when we're sick. But then, there are *other* kinds of plants. These special plants are not for food, not for flowers, and not for just any medicine. The plant we are talking about in Mama Esther's story is called 'cannabis'. It's sometimes called 'skunk' when it's dried up. This cannabis plant is a special kind that can make people feel very funny or strange if they use it. And sometimes, it's not good for their bodies or their minds. Did you know? Different plants have different uses. Some plants are good to eat, some are beautiful, and some are just not safe for us, especially without a doctor's help!

Why Are There Rules for Plants?

Just like we have rules at school (like 'no running in the hallway' or 'share your toys'), and rules at home (like 'finish your homework' or 'help with chores'), every country has rules. These rules are called 'laws'. Laws are there to keep everyone safe and happy. For the cannabis plant, many countries, including Nigeria, have a very important law: it is *against the rules* to sell or use this plant without special permission. Why? Because it can be harmful to people. It's not like selling oranges or pretty fabrics. It's something that can make people unhealthy or make bad choices. So, because it's not good for people and can cause problems, the government says 'No, you cannot sell this plant'. It's a very clear rule to protect everyone, big and small.

The Police Came to Ask Questions

One day, the police in Nigeria found Mama Esther. What do the police do? They are like helpers who make sure everyone follows the rules and stays safe. If someone breaks a rule, the police might come and ask them questions to understand what happened. In this story, the police found Mama Esther with small packets of this special plant, the 'skunk' cannabis. She was accused of selling these small packets. Because it's against the law to sell this plant, the police had to do their job. They had to take Mama Esther to ask her questions about the plant and why she had it. It's very unusual for someone so old, a great-grandmother of 101 years, to be involved in something like this. The police are now trying to understand everything. Remember, the police are there to keep order and make sure the rules are respected, for everyone, no matter how old they are. Did you know? Police officers work hard to protect their communities and help people stay safe by making sure laws are followed. They are like guardians for our towns and cities!

Why Is This Story Important?

This story about Mama Esther helps us remember a few important things. First, rules are for *everyone*. It doesn't matter if you are 7 years old or 101 years old. The rules are there to keep all of us safe and healthy. Even if Mama Esther is very old, the law still applies to her. Second, it's important to know what plants are safe and what plants are not. Always ask a grown-up if you are not sure about something. Never pick or eat a plant you don't know about. And third, sometimes people, even very old people, might make choices that are not good. We don't know why Mama Esther might have been selling this plant. Maybe she was confused, or maybe she needed money. But whatever the reason, breaking the law has consequences.

Always Follow the Rules!

So, what can we learn from Mama Esther's story? We learn that our world has rules, and these rules are like good friends that help us stay safe. It's always best to follow the rules and to be honest. If you ever see something that doesn't look right, or if you are not sure about a rule, talk to a trusted grown-up – your parents, your teachers, or another family member. Let's all try our best to follow the rules, be kind to each other, and help make our beautiful continent of Africa a wonderful and safe place for everyone. Thank you for listening, and until next time, keep being awesome!
summary: A 101-year-old great-grandmother named Mama Esther in Nigeria was questioned by police for allegedly selling small packets of a forbidden plant called 'cannabis' or 'skunk', reminding everyone that rules are important for all ages.
whyMatters: This story matters because it teaches us that rules (laws) are for everyone, no matter how old you are, and they help keep our communities safe from things that can be harmful, like certain special plants.

originalTitle: Four arrested over boxing champion's murder in South Africa
title: Police Are Helping After Sad News About a Boxing Champion
content:
A Champion Who Was Strong and Kind

Hello, my amazing friends! I'm your friendly news reporter for Africa. Today, I want to talk about someone very special. He was a champion! Do you know what a champion is? It's someone who is the very best at something. Like being the best runner, or the best swimmer, or the best at building super sandcastles! This champion was the best at boxing. Boxing is a sport where people use their hands to hit each other, but they wear big, soft gloves to keep safe. They train very hard to be strong and fast. This champion came from South Africa, a beautiful country in Africa. He was very famous for his boxing skills. His name was a bit long, but let's just call him our Boxing Hero for now. He worked so hard, and he won many fights. He made many people in South Africa feel very proud. Our Boxing Hero was a true hero, not just because he won. He was also brave and dedicated. He showed everyone that if you try your very best, you can achieve amazing things. Many young boys and girls looked up to him. They wanted to be like him when they grew up. They wanted to be strong and brave, just like our Boxing Hero. He was a good example for everyone. He taught us that hard work always pays off. He also taught us to be kind, even if we are super strong. Did you know? South Africa is a big country at the bottom of Africa, with beautiful mountains, sunny beaches, and lots of amazing animals like lions and elephants! Our Boxing Hero came from this wonderful place.

Something Very Sad Happened

Now, sometimes, very sad things happen in the world. And something very, very sad happened to our Boxing Hero. Someone did something very wrong and hurt him very badly. Because of this sad thing, our Boxing Hero is no longer with us. This made many, many people feel incredibly sad. It’s okay to feel sad when bad things happen to good people. When someone hurts another person, it's called doing a very bad thing. It's like breaking a super important rule about being kind and safe. Everyone felt very confused and upset. Why would someone hurt such a kind and strong champion? It was a very hard time for his family and friends. And for all the people who admired him so much. It's important to remember that we should always try to be kind to each other. We should treat everyone with respect, just like our Boxing Hero did. Hurting others is never okay. It brings sadness to so many people. We all want our world to be a safe and happy place, right? We want everyone to feel safe when they walk outside.

The Police Are Here to Help!

But here is some news that gives us hope! When something bad like this happens, we have very special helpers called the police. Have you seen police officers? They wear uniforms and sometimes have cool cars with flashing lights. Their job is to keep us safe. They are like real-life superheroes! When something goes wrong, they come to help. The police in South Africa started working very hard right away. They wanted to find out what happened to our Boxing Hero. They asked lots of questions. They looked for clues, just like a detective in a storybook. They talked to people who knew our champion. They looked at places where things happened. It's like putting together a giant puzzle with many tiny pieces! The police worked day and night, without stopping. They knew how important it was to find answers. They knew that many people were sad and wanted to understand why this happened. They promised everyone that they would do their very best. And guess what? They did! They are very good at their job. Did you know? Police officers train for a very long time to learn how to keep us safe and solve problems! They are very brave and clever!

Finding Answers and Helping Justice

After a lot of hard work, the police found some people. They found four people who they think were involved in the sad thing that happened to our Boxing Hero. Imagine, they found four people! This means the police were very, very good at their job. It means their hard work paid off and they followed all the clues. When the police find people they think did something wrong, they take them in to ask more questions. This helps to make sure that everyone is safe. It also helps to find out the truth. It's important to know who did what, so that we can learn from it and make sure it doesn't happen again. We want peace for everyone. One of these people will go to a special place called a court. A court is like a big room where a wise person called a judge sits. A judge is a very important person who listens to everyone. They listen to the police, and they listen to the people who are accused of doing something wrong. The judge tries to understand everything and decide what is fair and right. It's a very serious place. Did you know? Judges often wear special robes, sometimes black, and they listen very carefully to decide what is fair. It's a very important job to make sure rules are followed!

What Happens Next?

So, on a special day called Monday, one of the people the police found will go to court. The judge will listen to what the police say. The police will tell the judge about all the clues they found. They will explain why they think this person did something wrong. This is called being "charged" with something. It means the police are saying, "We think this person broke the rules and did a very bad thing." The person will be charged with hurting our champion and trying to hurt someone else too. This is a very serious charge. The judge will listen to everything. Then, everyone will work together to find out the whole story. It might take some time, because finding the whole truth takes patience and careful listening. But the good news is that the police are doing their job very well. They are helping to make sure that everyone gets a fair chance to tell their side of the story. And they are helping to make sure that if someone did something wrong, they will learn that it is not okay. This is called justice. Justice means making things fair and right for everyone in our community.

Remembering Our Hero

Even though our Boxing Hero is not with us anymore, we will always remember him. We will remember his strength, his bravery, and his kindness. He taught us that it's important to work hard and to be a good person. He was a shining star in South Africa and a role model for many. His spirit will live on in our hearts. And we can all learn from this sad news. We can learn that it's super important to be kind to each other every single day. To look out for our friends and family. And to trust the police when things go wrong, because they are there to help us and keep our neighbourhoods safe. The police will keep working until all the answers are found. And we can all hope for justice for our beloved champion. Let's send love to his family and remember all the good things he brought to the world. And let's all try to be heroes in our own ways, by being kind and helpful every single day, just like our champion taught us!
summary: Police in South Africa have found four people they think hurt a brave boxing champion, and one person will go to court soon to help find out what happened and make things fair.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows that police work very hard to find answers when sad things happen, and they help make sure things are fair for everyone, especially for heroes like our champion who made many people proud.
